name: Science & Technology
description: Big developments in tech and science worth knowing about. Think major product launches, breakthroughs, or moves from companies like Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, Apple. Also notable scientific discoveries or research that made headlines. Skip minor updates and routine announcements.

name: AI Safety & Alignment
description: Research and discussions on making AI systems safe, aligned with human values, and interpretable. Includes technical alignment research, governance, existential risk perspectives, and developments in the broader AI safety ecosystem.

name: Greece
description: General news from Greece covering politics, economy, and society. Write the section in English. Focus on significant political developments, economic news, and major societal stories. Ignore celebrity gossip, reality TV, sports results, and lifestyle content.

name: Markets & Investing
description: Market news and economic developments. Focus on things that could meaningfully affect global markets — Fed decisions, inflation, major earnings, geopolitical developments, sector trends. Skip day-trading noise and crypto.
